actor: AI-chip vendor investor-relations & FP&A guidance function
job: Set the next quarter's data-center / AI-semiconductor revenue guide and decide whether to raise the full-year AI forecast on the upcoming earnings call.
outcome: An in-line (meets-not-raises) AI guide that clears the prior quarter but sits below the raised consensus bar, opening the gap that triggers the drop.
motivation: Guide conservatively to protect credibility and avoid an over-promise, while not flagging a fundamentals miss.

task.who: Investor-relations team and FP&A / financial-planning function
task.what: Finalize next-quarter AI-revenue guide and full-year stance
task.where: Quarterly earnings call, press release, and guidance slides
task.when: Earnings-prep window before the next print, through Q4 2026
task.why: A merely-solid in-line guide reads as a miss versus the raised bar
task.how: Consensus-vs-guide framing; channel and backlog visibility

job: Re-run AI-chip revenue and margin models against the in-line guide and publish revised estimates, price targets, and ratings across the accelerator/HBM group.
outcome: Visible sell-side estimate cuts or a coverage re-rating that trims AI-chip revenue and target assumptions for the reporting name and its peers.
motivation: Realign published estimates and targets with the de-anchored expectations to stay accurate and protect coverage credibility.

task.what: Cut AI-chip estimates and trim price targets group-wide
task.where: Post-earnings research notes and revised target models
task.when: Hours-to-days after the next in-line print, by Q4 2026
task.why: Estimates priced for beat-and-raise must be marked down

actor: Institutional portfolio managers and traders holding the AI-accelerator complex
job: Reprice and rotate AI-accelerator and high-bandwidth-memory positions when the in-line guide breaks the beat-and-raise expectation that justified the valuations.
outcome: A double-digit single-session drop in the reporting name and a correlated sell-off across accelerator and HBM peers.
motivation: De-risk positions priced for continuous beat-and-raise once the expectations asymmetry turns a solid quarter into a disappointment.

task.who: Tech / semiconductor sector fund managers and trading desks
task.what: Sell and reweight the AI-accelerator and HBM group
task.where: Public equity markets during and after the print session
task.when: Reporting session and following days, through Q4 2026
task.why: In-line guide invalidates the beat-and-raise pricing thesis
task.how: Sector-correlation repricing; momentum and risk-model de-grossing
